generation_settings.grammar:
char ::= [^"\\\x7F\x00-\x1F] | [\\] (["\\bfnrt] | "u" [0-9a-fA-F]{4})
decimal-part ::= [0-9]{1,16}
integral-part ::= [0] | [1-9] [0-9]{0,15}
json-array ::= "[" space ("]" | json-value (space "," space json-value)* space "]")
json-bool ::= "true" | "false"
json-null ::= "null"
json-number ::= "-"? ("0" | [1-9] [0-9]*) ("." [0-9]+)? (("e" | "E") [+-]? [0-9]+)?
json-object ::= "{" space ("}" | json-string space ":" space json-value (space "," space json-string space ":" space json-value)* space "}")
json-string ::= "\"" ( [^"\\] | "\\" ( ["\\/ bfnrt] | "u" [0-9a-fA-F]{4} ) )* "\""
json-value ::= json-object | json-array | json-string | json-number | json-bool | json-null
number ::= ("-"? integral-part) ("." decimal-part)? ([eE] [-+]? integral-part)?
response-format ::= "{" space response-format-tool-kv "," space response-format-order-id-kv "," space response-format-amount-kv "," space response-format-reason-kv space "}"
response-format-amount ::= "{" space response-format-amount-value-kv "," space response-format-amount-unit-kv space "}"
response-format-amount-kv ::= "\"amount\"" space ":" space response-format-amount
response-format-amount-unit ::= ("\"CNY\"" | "\"USD\"" | "\"EUR\"" | "\"pcs\"" | "\"kg\"")
response-format-amount-unit-kv ::= "\"unit\"" space ":" space response-format-amount-unit
response-format-amount-value-kv ::= "\"value\"" space ":" space number
response-format-order-id-kv ::= "\"order_id\"" space ":" space string
response-format-reason ::= ("\"damaged_item\"" | "\"late_delivery\"" | "\"wrong_item\"" | "\"duplicate_charge\"" | "\"price_mismatch\"")
response-format-reason-kv ::= "\"reason\"" space ":" space response-format-reason
response-format-tool ::= ("\"orders.lookup_order\"" | "\"orders.cancel_order\"" | "\"orders.get_refund_eligibility\"" | "\"refunds.submit\"" | "\"customers.get_profile\"" | "\"logistics.trace_shipment\"" | "\"inventory.check_stock\"" | "\"notify.send_update\"")
response-format-tool-kv ::= "\"tool\"" space ":" space response-format-tool
root ::= "<|im_start|>assistant\n" "<think>" space until-2 space "</think>" space response-format
space ::= | " " | "\n"{1,2} [ \t]{0,20}
string ::= "\"" char* "\""
until-2 ::= | [<] until-2-01 | [^<] until-2
until-2-01 ::= | [<] until-2-01 | [/] until-2-02 | [^/<] until-2
until-2-02 ::= | [<] until-2-01 | [t] until-2-03 | [^<t] until-2
until-2-03 ::= | [<] until-2-01 | [h] until-2-04 | [^<h] until-2
until-2-04 ::= | [<] until-2-01 | [i] until-2-05 | [^<i] until-2
until-2-05 ::= | [<] until-2-01 | [n] until-2-06 | [^<n] until-2
until-2-06 ::= | [<] until-2-01 | [k] until-2-07 | [^<k] until-2
until-2-07 ::= | [<] until-2-01 | [^<>] until-2
